reviewer_role: Independent precision arithmetic and prospective supportive-protocol Reviewer Gate
decision: Adopt the precision calculations as conditional design scenarios and descriptive arithmetic, with the rejection-power versus directional-support distinction below. The reviewed GSE73661 supportive-only draft and code may be frozen for later execution without changing the GSE23597 primary lock. No GSE73661 result or full-model precision has been assessed.

numeric_recomputation.source: Original discovery and GSE23597 fit X/y, and their already available gene-delta matrices; no new outcome search.
numeric_recomputation.methods: Source original fit matrices/responses exported with R; independent NumPy SVD estimates/residual SD, projection-based response VIF, SciPy noncentral-t CDF/SF, chi-square quantiles and Brent root solver; no GSE73661 expression read.

power_definition_clarification.calculated_quantity: Probability of rejecting the two-sided zero-effect null in either tail under fixed X, plug-in residual sigma and an assumed true effect.
power_definition_clarification.not_identical_quantity: The earlier positive-coefficient plus two-sided P<0.05 support rule uses only the positive rejection tail.
power_definition_clarification.required_reporting: Call 27.0218% two-sided rejection power under the stated assumptions, not the probability that the frozen positive-direction validation succeeds. The latter is 26.9748% under the same assumptions. Do not alter the frozen primary rule or substitute either power quantity for the observed test result.

interpretation_audit: The .5994069273 effect is an illustrative assumed true effect drawn from a selected discovery estimate; it is not established as the transportable true effect in another cohort.

The 1.248127 MDE is conditional on fixed observed GSE23597 design, residual-sigma plug-in and a homoscedastic normal linear model. It is not an empirical biological detection boundary or a claim that smaller effects cannot exist.

Observed power at .400823 is .1468094 and is recorded only for arithmetic auditing. Because it is computed from the observed estimate and SE, it supplies no independent explanation for a nonsignificant result.

The exact SE factorization is sigmaV/sigmaD times sqrt(nD/nV) times response-balance factor times sqrt(response-VIFV/response-VIFD). The product equals 1.8989954. It is an algebraic description, not causal decomposition of platform/treatment/cohort effects.

Raw delta-SD and residual-sigma ratios are different quantities. The raw score SD ratio near 1.497 includes biological, treatment, patient, time, technical and random variability. Without shared biospecimens measured under both processes, a pure RMA-to-GCOS noise multiplier cannot be identified.
The variance-of-score identity includes gene cross-covariances; an average of genes does not by itself prove technical-noise amplification.
Changes in response coefficients after conditioning on inflammation are descriptive model comparisons, not a mediated proportion or causal attenuation estimate.
Residual-sigma intervals use chi-square variance uncertainty under model assumptions; they are not a full interval for cross-cohort power including effect/design uncertainty.

GSE73661 scenarios use 23 patients, 8 healing/15 nonhealing, expected four parameters/df19, and external sigma by VIF grids. Actual expression covariate correlations and residual variance remain unknown; no actual GSE73661 power is claimed.
Future sample-size scenarios preserve the current response fraction as an illustrative design assumption. They do not guarantee future response counts or empirical covariance.

supportive_plan_static_review.R_syntax_parse_only: All three reviewed R files parsed successfully; support script was not sourced or executed.
supportive_plan_static_review.scope: GSE73661 IFX 23 pairs; post-treatment Mayo endoscopic subscore0/1 at deposited W4/6 window. This differs from GSE23597 clinical response.
supportive_plan_static_review.role: descriptive_supportive_only; cannot replace or rescue the failed GSE23597 fixed primary test.
code_checks: Reads adjusted and parallel formulas from the separate frozen support plan.
Requires frozen supportive-only plan and fixed pair file; preserves explicit source pairing and 8 healing/15 nonhealing.
Candidate membership, all six measured genes and all common194 measured genes are required; deposited log2 probes are averaged only after canonicalization.
RMA-compatible finite numerical scale is checked; no second log2 or normalization is applied.
All three predeclared candidate models report OLS and HC3 residual-df t intervals and exact nominal P values.
Rank-deficient support/auxiliary/reference branches and LOPO are recognized without switching a model to rescue significance.
Patient leverage, Cook distance and all LOPO fits are reported without automatic patient deletion.
Three reference programs use fixed BH(n=3); no pooled P value, superiority-by-P comparison, or replacement primary is computed.
No artificial visit or numeric-dose covariate is introduced because these are not supplied at patient level.
supportive_plan_static_review.future_adoption_boundary: After authorized expression access, independently compare the newly downloaded full header with frozen source metadata, verify actual mapping/scale/coverage and reproduce numerical fits before adopting results. This static review cannot certify those unseen values.
supportive_plan_static_review.freeze_recommendation: No blocking issue; freeze the reviewed supportive-only plan and associated input hashes, preserving the original GSE23597 lock unchanged.

reviewer_computation_note.issue: SciPy1.17.1 returned NaN for an extreme negative-tail nct.cdf during the reviewer root-solver bracket. This was a reviewer-library numerical edge case, not a production-R error.
reviewer_computation_note.resolution: Used the exact noncentral-t symmetry CDF(-c;df,ncp)=SF(c;df,-ncp), retaining the same two-sided probability and target. Final independent calculations agree with production R at about1e-12; only the final numeric artifact is authoritative.

access_and_mutation_scope: No GSE73661 expression was accessed or downloaded. Only new 002B reviewer artifacts were written; no previous manifest, frozen input, primary validation result or scientific code was modified.
